name: Content, upcoming events
description: A list of upcoming events, each with a date badge, time, place, a short text, an optional status tag and a link.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Come and meet the animals this autumn

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Every event raises money for the dogs, cats and rabbits in our care at Willow Bank Animal Rescue. Friendly dogs on leads are welcome unless we say otherwise.

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Text
itemFields.default: Say who it is for and what to bring in one or two sentences.

itemFields.name: tag
itemFields.label: Status tag
itemFields.help: For example Free or Sold out.

itemFields.name: linkLabel
itemFields.label: Link text
itemFields.help: Leave empty to hide the link.

default.title: Autumn adoption day
default.location: Willow Bank Rescue Centre, Mill Lane
default.text: Meet the animals looking for a home, talk to the people who care for them and start an application on the day.

default.title: Five mile charity dog walk
default.location: Meet at the Riverside Park bandstand
default.text: Bring your own dog or borrow one of ours. Every pound of sponsorship pays for vet care this winter.

default.title: New volunteer induction
default.location: Training room, Willow Bank Rescue Centre
default.text: An evening introduction for new kennel hands, cat socialisers and charity shop helpers. No experience needed.

default.title: Charity quiz night
default.location: The Fox and Hounds, Church Street
default.text: Teams of up to six, eight rounds and a raffle. Tickets are £8 each and include a hot supper.
